entries.speaker: Guard Captain
entries.en: Be glad that your punishment has been[n]decided upon.

entries.speaker: Guard Captain
entries.en: Your charge is "unlawful entry."

entries.speaker: Guard Captain
entries.en: Thus, you will be sentenced to death.

entries.speaker: Vulgar Boy
entries.en: Say what!?

entries.speaker: Familiar Voice
entries.en: No one's allowed to do as they please in[n]my castle.
entries.uk: Ніхто не сміє робити що заманеться[n]в моєму замку.

entries.speaker: Vulgar Boy
entries.en: Huh? Wait... Is that you, Kamoshida?
Who?
Kamoshida?

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: I thought it was some petty thief, but[n]to think it'd be you, Sakamoto...
entries.uk: Я думав, це якийсь дрібний злодюжка, а[n]це, виявляється, ти, Сакамото...

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: Are you trying to disobey me again?[n]It looks like you haven't learned your[n]lesson at all, huh?
entries.uk: Знову намагаєшся мені не коритися?[n]Схоже, ти так нічого[n]й не зрозумів, га?

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: And you brought a friend this time...[n]because you can't do anything for[n]yourself.
entries.uk: Та ще й друга цього разу привів...[n]бо сам нічого[n]не можеш.

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: This ain't funny, you asshole!

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: Is that how you speak to a king? It seems[n]you don't understand the position you're[n]in at all.
entries.uk: Так ти говориш із королем? Схоже,[n]ти геть не розумієш свого[n]становища.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: Not only did you sneak into my castle,[n]you committed the crime of insulting[n]me—the king.
entries.uk: Ти не лише прокрався до мого замку,[n]а й скоїв злочин — образив[n]мене, короля.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: The punishment for that is death.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: It's time for an execution! Take him out!

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: S-Stop it!

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: ...Goddammit!

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Hragh!

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: I ain't down for this shit! C'mon, we're[n]outta here!
entries.uk: Я на таке не підписувався! Давай,[n]валимо звідси!

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Nnngh... Owww...

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Just go! Get outta here! These guys are[n]serious!
entries.uk: Просто йди! Тікай звідси! Ці типи[n]не жартують!

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: Oh? Running away, are we? What a[n]heartless friend you are.
entries.uk: О? Тікаєш, значить? Ну й безсердечний[n]із тебе друг.

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: He ain't a friend...

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: C'mon! Hurry up and go!

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: What's the matter? Too scared to[n]run away?

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: Hmph, pathetic scum isn't worth[n]my time...
entries.uk: Хм, жалюгідне сміття не варте[n]мого часу...

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: I'll focus on this one's execution...

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: Get him.

entries.speaker: (SE)坂本 竜司
entries.en: That's not true!

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: Take this!

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: Lowly scum!

entries.speaker: Kamoshida...?
entries.en: Useless pest!
